source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with layered misty mountains, steep striated cliffs, dense groves, secluded walled pavilions with scholar figures, rocky ravines, river water, and a small boat. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper tone are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain range in the upper center: soft distant peaks and layered ridgelines emerging through mist behind the darker foreground mountains.
must_preserve: faint ink-wash silhouettes of rear peaks
soft mist edges between peaks
light dry-brush contour lines on the nearer ridges
subtle gray-green wash transitions
small dark tree dots along ridge crests

motifs.name: upper_right_waterfall_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall upper-right cliff mass with rounded summit, vertical striated rock face, dark vegetation clusters, and the narrow waterfall descending along the right side of the cliff.
must_preserve: arched hemp-fiber rock strokes following the cliff curvature
dark stippled moss and shrub dots on ledges
thin vertical waterfall line and pale wash beside it
soft misty base where the cliff fades
layered ink density from crown to cliff face

motifs.name: left_wooded_cliff_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the broad left-side middle cliff and sloping wooded ridge, including the rounded rock face, treeline along the crest, and scattered leafless and leafy trees on the slope.
must_preserve: curving parallel rock texture strokes
dark dotted vegetation along the ridge edge
thin angular branch linework
light wash on rounded cliff planes
irregular shrub silhouettes at the left and upper crest

motifs.name: central_rocky_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the central ravine and stepped rock corridor between the large cliffs, including the pale rocky path, jagged ledges, narrow cleft, and sparse shrubs clinging to the sides.
must_preserve: broken angular outline of the stacked rock ledges
dry-brush cracks and pale wash on stone planes
dark shrub dots tracing the ravine edge
mist-softened negative space in the cleft
vertical transition from upper passage to lower rocks

motifs.name: dense_bamboo_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central-lower grove of bamboo, pine, and mixed trees surrounding the settlement, excluding the building walls and roofs where possible while keeping foliage that overlaps naturally.
must_preserve: fine bamboo leaf clusters drawn with repeated pointed strokes
vertical trunks with knotted bark marks
dark pine needle fans and layered foliage clumps
leafless branch networks interlaced among leafy trees
ink variation between pale background trees and dark foreground foliage

motifs.name: walled_pavilion_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the secluded village/pavilion compound in the lower middle-left: stone walls, tiled roofs, open pavilion, courtyard rooms, and seated scholar figures partially framed by trees.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with dark tile-line hatching
stone wall pattern made of irregular polygon lines
open pavilion posts and railings
small seated scholar figures and table gestures
courtyard layering partly obscured by trunks and foliage

motifs.name: right_curving_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the monumental right-side rounded cliff face rising beside the village, including its dark mossy rim, sweeping vertical striations, lower rock ledges, and adjoining small shrub-covered slope.
must_preserve: long sweeping contour strokes following the cliff bend
dense dark moss dots along the ridge and shoulder
pale ink wash gradients across the rock face
small blocky ledges at the cliff base
contrast between massive smooth face and rough shrub patches

motifs.name: foreground_boat_on_river
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the lower river with two figures, low canopy, oar/boat details, and the surrounding rippled water immediately around it.
must_preserve: slender boat hull linework
two small human figures seated or standing in the boat
rectangular low canopy with dark roof wash
fine repeated water-ripple strokes around the hull
subtle scale relationship between boat and open river surface

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
